checks.detail: Frontend, native and Rust version authorities identify 5.4.0.
The authoritative roadmap records the complete implementation and audit contract.
All eleven gameplay components have data classes, stable registry descriptors, persistence factories and normalization.
Pending/instance handles, generations, targeted operations and explicit stale failures are wired through the host command boundary.
Typed scene queries and snapshot reads declare deterministic hard bounds.
Gameplay initialization, fixed-step update and collision dispatch are connected to live runtime phases.
Pause, restart, transition, checkpoint, score/session and quit share API-v2 commands.
Contexts, maps, schemes, interactions, consumption, priority and callbacks persist and have authoring controls.
Behavior trees and state machines share graph trace/error/coverage/timing and profiler infrastructure.
Gameplay components and advanced input are reachable from responsive editor authoring surfaces.
All new visible controls have English, German and Chinese strings.
English/Chinese README and offline EN/DE/ZH manuals teach the v5.4 workflows and link focused guides.
Five gameplay references pass deterministic component/API/static-script verification.
Browser layout qualification passed EN/DE/ZH at four required viewports.
Generic packager enforces the exact eleven-file release contract.
